featured_reviews.name: Vimal Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
The biggest issue is the deposit refund. The owner does not return the full deposit and creates unnecessary problems during the process. In my case, only around 60% of the deposit was returned, and the remaining amount was deducted without any clear or valid explanation. Charges were applied arbitrarily, which felt unfair.

I had to call more than 30 times just to get updates on my deposit, and many times the owner did not even pick up the calls. This made the whole process very frustrating and unprofessional.

Major suggestion: do not leave the PG until your full deposit is returned, as it becomes very difficult to recover the remaining amount later.

The PG had basic amenities and was manageable for staying, but there were several issues. Initially, there were problems with filtered water and the AC, which caused inconvenience. Although the owner fixed these after complaints, it took time and effort to get them resolved. Cleaning was done daily, which is a positive point, but there were still cockroaches in the kitchen, which was not hygienic.

featured_reviews.review_text: Dhirubhai PG is not just about staying , it’s about living right. The management is supportive, safety is well taken care of, and the overall vibe stays calm and respectful. People who live here understand the comfort, discipline, and convenience it offers. As for the haters , when a place does things right, noise is inevitable. Quality doesn’t argue, it simply exists. Those who know, know. ✨💯

Sharing my honest experience so others can stay cautious before booking this PG.

During my stay, I personally faced several issues, the room cleanliness was poor, I often noticed cockroaches inside the room, and even found hair in the food served. The deposit refund process was unclear, and there were some confusions related to the electricity bill as well.
Deposit was not given back even after calling multiple times, when negative review was posted by me earlier, the pg owner prashant threatend me to remove or else he'll put case on me and won't give my deposit back. I am not afraid now because he has still not given my deposit

I’m sharing this so others can double-check everything before finalizing.

Tips for students:

Don’t book any PG just by seeing photos.

Visit the place personally before paying.

Take videos when giving advance and while checking room condition.

Clarify deposit and EB terms in writing.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Since my daughter lived there for 2 years , I can give a fair idea to how the hostel actually is as of date. So it is overpriced excluding food, earlier food used to be included and they used to charge 15000 for 4 sharing bunk beds , after excluding food they charge 13000??!
Another thing is extremely small 4 sharing rooms like matchbox and they have bunk beds, at summer or afternoon , it is impossible to stay in the room. There is a centralized AC which they don't turn on when it's needed during afternoon.
Now the toilets are unhygienic, the warden Is rude and unmannered. There is a different rule for bathing time for a group of people and others. And they can bathe for entire day but the same if anyone else does it, they would target you. They will call you out, like they are paying more rent ??
You can get a better hostel at this price like shraddhanand which is close to flower market.

featured_reviews.name: Rutuja Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to give feedback regarding the hostel facilities and management. My experience in this hostel has been very disappointing.
Firstly, the behavior of the hostel warden is very rude and unprofessional. Students are not treated properly, which creates an uncomfortable environment.
Secondly, the hostel hygiene is extremely poor. There are many big rats inside the hostel premises, even in the kitchen area, which is very unhygienic and unsafe for students.
Another major issue is the government washroom located near the hostel. It smells very bad all the time, making it difficult to stay comfortably in the hostel surroundings.
Additionally, the hostel is very congested. Proper air and ventilation are not available, and fresh air or wind hardly comes inside the rooms. This makes the living conditions unhealthy and uncomfortable.
I request the management to take immediate action to improve cleanliness, hygiene, ventilation, and student treatment in the hostel.
Very very very bad experience in this hostel☹️

featured_reviews.name: Pratik Borkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a very good experience staying at Sharad PG. All the amenities were available and well maintained, which made my stay comfortable and hassle free. The biggest plus point is its prime location, very close to the office, which saved a lot of travel time. Overall, a great place to stay and I would definitely recommend it.

featured_reviews.name: Naman Kedia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pros:
1. Office, food options, malls, pvr(phoenix Mall), local stores, railway station, monorail station,etc. all were at just 5-10 minutes of walk.

2. Flat had everything installed including AC, beds, almirah, fans, 2 western bathrooms, fridge, induction, washing machine, water filter, geyser, wifi. No shortage of water or electricity supply.

3. One can also enjoy all the festivals at this prime location. Ganesh Chaturthi(Lalbaug is nearby), Janmashtami, Navratri,etc. It's really happening and vibrant in that part of Mumbai.

Cons:
1. One issue was of disturbance due to noise of trains especially in work from home, though one may get used to it. At a point one may even enjoy passing of trains.

2. Other issue might be of rats near building and a few times dirt/trash did came through window.

3. If you are bachelor, budget might be an issue

Overall it was a good experience.
